identity.description: Hides a secret message inside ordinary-looking cover text using a reverse-engineered Vigenère key, and reveals it again.

inputs.description: Hide a secret message inside cover text (mode: "hide") or reveal a secret from cover text + key (mode: "reveal"). The pre-filled example above is for "hide" — for "reveal", try: {"mode": "reveal", "coverText": "Just a reminder that the quarterly report is due Friday, please send it over whenever you get a chance, thanks so much!", "key": "|0.  s:r$xiy{ r*!r ( ${$<,iaY$wd"}. That key is the real one this agent's own "hide" example above produces, so it decodes back to "Meet me at the usual place, 9pm."

example.secretMessage: Meet me at the usual place, 9pm.
example.coverText: Just a reminder that the quarterly report is due Friday, please send it over whenever you get a chance, thanks so much!

mode.description: "hide" derives a key from secretMessage + coverText. "reveal" decodes coverText + key back into the secret.

secretMessage.description: The message to hide. Required for mode "hide".

coverText.description: The innocuous-looking text to hide the message inside (mode "hide"), or the text the key was derived from (mode "reveal"). Must be at least as long as secretMessage once non-printable characters are stripped.

key.description: The key produced by a previous "hide" call. Required for mode "reveal".

outputs.description: The derived key, produced when mode is "hide". Share this and the full coverText with your contact so they can reveal the secret.
The revealed secret message, produced when mode is "reveal".

tags.name: Steganography
tags.description: Hides a message inside innocuous-looking text using a Vigenère-derived key rather than producing gibberish ciphertext.
examples: hide a secret message in text
